candidate.represented_pixel_finding: Large result headlines, numbers, plots, bars, matrices, and conclusions remain primary. Fine axes, error bars, legends, caveats, citations, provenance, and small support are less uniformly reliable. Missing structural hold is not repaired by removing or remapping color.

acceptance_guard_for_future_hwao_authore: After each declared native grayscale or fixed color-vision presentation transform followed by Pillow LANCZOS 640x360, all seven exact scene-specific gates and all seven complete RESULT HELD capsules must remain directly readable at represented pixels.

Every required status, branch, comparison, equation term, axis, unit, value, error bar, threshold, unavailable rung, uncertainty, qualifier, provenance fact, and interpretation boundary must use a direct label plus at least one non-color channel such as shape, line style, marker, border, connector, stable position, pattern, or status column.
Hue may reinforce meaning but may not be the sole carrier of scientific category, sign, direction, threshold crossing, availability, unresolved state, result status, or authorization boundary.
Plot legends and matrix labels must name each category directly; matched geometry alone or color similarity under a transform is not sufficient.
Human review of represented pixels, complete containers, clipping, overlap, and ambiguity remains decisive; global OCR and simulated color matrices are reproducible aids only.
The exact compound transform must be independently recomputed from each native source; matching hashes or receipts alone cannot certify it.
